## What this changes

Brief description of the change and the problem it solves. Link any related
issue with `Fixes #123`.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor / internal cleanup

## Checklist

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests` passes
- [ ] Added a test that fails without this change
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies
- [ ] No test reaches the network (`urlopen` is stubbed)
- [ ] Updated the README if user-facing behaviour changed
- [ ] Added a `CHANGELOG.md` entry under "Unreleased"

## Notes for the reviewer

Anything surprising, any trade-off you made, or anything you would like a second
opinion on.
